raw.rationale: Timofibrate is a lipoprotein lipase (LPL)-targeting fibrate with no known cytotoxic or lineage-selective anticancer mechanism at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-concentration data for such metabolic agents typically show no lineage selectivity above base rates. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the 0.2–2.5% per-lineage base rate, with minor variation for lineages where LPL/PPAR biology or transporter expression might marginally alter viability.
